name: The Druid Who Came Back
summary: Davian's pickers watch a lantern go round and round the crown of Yester Hill at night, where the Gulthias tree burned, like somebody digging.

stages.journal: There's a lantern on the crown of Yester Hill at night, where the Gulthias tree burned. Davian's pickers say it goes round and round, slow, like somebody digging. He wants it stopped.
objectives: Go up Yester Hill after dark
stages.hint: Climb to the crown of Yester Hill after dark and see who carries the lantern.

stages.journal: Someone came back to the burned crown of Yester Hill with something to plant, and the old tree's roots under the hill have taken it.
objectives: Deal with what's growing on the crown
stages.hint: Deal with what's growing on the crown of Yester Hill; talking first may tell you how.

stages.journal: The ash of Wintersplinter stood up round the new planting on Yester Hill, and we put it down again. Fire was no use; it had burned once already.
stages.hint: Go back to the Wizard of Wines and tell Davian Martikov the lantern's out.

stages.journal: The lantern on Yester Hill is out. Davian says the hill looked grey this morning, not black, and paid us from the barrel he was saving for his funeral.
